_comment: The MCP config the plugin ships: Claude Code connects straight to a running luxd, with no per-session process in the path. A session's menu entries are owned by its applets (lux-beads and the like), which the session-start hook launches and which hold their own connection to luxd — the tool surface and the menu entries are separate connections by design. luxd must be running (lux hub-install, or luxd in a terminal). The url below hard-codes the default port 8430; luxd may bind a different (ephemeral) port, so read the actual port from the hub.port file (HubPaths().read_port(), i.e. ~/.punt-labs/lux/hub.port) and update the url to match. The lux repository's scripts/direct_connection_probe.py resolves the port that way and verifies the endpoint end to end; it is a development tool and is not part of this plugin, so it is not installed alongside this file — see https://github.com/punt-labs/lux.
